svg.text: OMNIA-Demo: An interactive architecture for KG completion, inspection, and system demonstration

text.tspan: A user-friendly interface for loading a KG, browsing
clusters, inspecting missing triples, and watching
The demo highlights density, connected components,
isolated nodes, and low-support clusters so sparse-
graph failure cases are visible to the audience.
Head entities grouped by a shared (Relation, Tail) key.
Generated triples keep provenance so the audience can

g.text: Status path: Generated → Filtered → Scored → Accepted

text.tspan: Your task is to only transform the triple
into a sentence, no matter if it is correct
or not. Do not rephrase incorrect facts.

g.text: Head: chloroquine Rel: inhibits Tail: sars-cov-2

text.tspan: Missing labels are created for evaluation.
